meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of recall notices published by the Consumer Product Safety Commission, kept for research and market sizing. A recall is not a finding that a product caused any harm to any person, and it says nothing about whether anyone has a claim; deadlines for injury claims differ by state. Questions about an injury are for a licensed attorney.
